page.title: My reports and decisions
page.intro: What happened to the reports you sent, and any decisions our team made about your posts. A person reads every report.
page.signedOut: Log in to see your reports and decisions.
page.loadFailed: We couldn't load your reports and decisions. Check your connection and try again.
page.contactBody: Write to the moderation team about a report or a decision.

decisions.heading: Decisions about your posts
decisions.empty: Our team hasn't made any decisions about your posts.

titles.restrict: We limited who sees something you posted
titles.public_note: We added a note to your story
titles.ai_label_added: We labelled your story as AI-written

did.hide: We hid it from everyone but you. You can still see it. Your account isn't affected.
did.remove: We removed it. A note shows where it was. Your account isn't affected.
did.restrict: We limited who can see it.
did.warn: This is a warning on your account. Nothing you posted changed, and you can keep posting.
did.suspend: Your account is read-only until {{date}}. You can still read, but you can't post, comment or send messages until then.
did.suspendNoDate: Your account is read-only for now. You can still read.
did.ban: Your account is closed for good, and the email address can't be used to join again.
did.public_note: We added a note to the story saying it copies a published work.
did.reporting_pause: You can't send reports until {{date}}. Everything else works as before.
did.reporting_pauseNoDate: You can't send reports for now. Everything else works as before.
did.rating_raised: We raised the story's rating, so younger readers no longer see it. The words are unchanged.
did.ai_label_added: We added the label "AI-written, not disclosed" to the story. The words are unchanged.

decisions.noFacts: The moderator didn't add more details. Write to us if you'd like to know more.

rules.authority_order: a removal order from a competent authority (Regulation (EU) 2021/784)

decisions.foundByPerson: Someone reported it, or our team saw it. A moderator read it and decided. No automated tools made this decision.
decisions.foundAutomatically: Our automatic picture check flagged it. A moderator looked at it and decided. No automated tools made this decision.

explain.waiting: We got your report. Nothing changes until we've checked it.
explain.removed: It broke our rules or the law, so we removed it.
explain.no_action: We checked it and it doesn't break our rules or the law, so we left it up.

appeals.until: You can appeal this decision until {{date}} (six months). Appealing is free.
appeals.how: Tell us why the decision is wrong. A different moderator looks at it where possible, and we write to you with the outcome.
appeals.label: Why is this decision wrong?
appeals.hint: Say what we got wrong. You can add anything that helps, such as context we didn't have.
appeals.open: Your appeal {{reference}} was sent on {{date}}. A moderator is looking at it; we'll write to you with the outcome.

outcomes.upheld: We looked again ({{reference}}): the decision stands.
outcomes.overturned: We looked again ({{reference}}) and changed the decision.

appeals.ended: The time to appeal this ended on {{date}}.

failures.refused: This decision can't be appealed right now: an appeal is already open, or the six months have ended.
failures.too_many: You've sent a lot of appeals in the last hour. Try again in {{minutes}} minutes.
failures.not_found: We couldn't find this decision on your account.
failures.unreachable: We couldn't send your appeal. Check your connection and try again.
